title: Naughty Girls of Tamriel SSE AIO - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 11 NPCs from Naughty Girls of Tamriel SSE AIO.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by Naughty Girls of Tamriel SSE AIO (Naughty Girls of Tamriel SSE AIO.esp).

Install this if Naughty Girls of Tamriel SSE AIO.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
